purpose: Structured checklist for research sub-agents. Each archetype defines the specific data fields to collect during web research (Step 3). Sub-agents should attempt to fill every field. Mark fields as null with a brief reason if the information cannot be found — this surfaces gaps honestly rather than hiding them.

identity.known_as: string — one-line positioning: what they're known for

origin.family_context: string — socioeconomic background, parents' occupations, family dynamics
origin.formative_environment: string — the world they grew up in, cultural/political/economic context
education: string — institution, field, years, notable mentors or experiences
early_influences: string — people, books, events, ideologies that shaped their worldview
origin.the_spark: string — specific moment or decision that launched them onto their known path
early_moves: string — first ventures, roles, publications, failures before they became 'them'

arc_of_decisions.context: string — the situation and options they faced
arc_of_decisions.reveals_about_thinking: string — what this decision tells us about how they operate

operating_style.recurring_patterns: string — how they handle adversity, opportunity, conflict

current_state.public_perception: string — how are they viewed right now?

key_contemporaries: string — who else operates in their space

identity.name: string
identity.type: string — public company, private, nonprofit, government, etc.

origin.founding_context: string — market/political/social environment that made this possible
origin.initial_vision: string — what they set out to build
origin.vs_reality: string — how different was early version from what it became
origin.early_survival: string — existential threats, critical decisions, lucky breaks

evolution.phase_name: string — e.g., 'the growth phase', 'the pivot', 'the crisis'
evolution.transition_to_next: string — how this phase led to the next

operating_model.business_model: string — how it makes money or sustains itself

key_metrics.metric_name: value — ARR, users, market share, etc.

core_capabilities: string — what it's genuinely better at
operating_model.real_culture: string — not the PR version, evidenced by decisions

competitive_landscape.market_dynamics: string — growing, consolidating, fragmenting? who has momentum?

common_praises: string — from forums, reviews, social media

identity.name: string
identity.type: string — software, hardware, protocol, drug, creative work, etc.

how_it_works.core_mechanism: string — fundamental approach, architecture, or principle
key_components: string — main parts or features and how they fit together
how_it_works.user_experience: string — what it feels like to use/interact with
technical_choices: string — important design decisions and their tradeoffs
limitations: string — what it can't do, where it breaks down

origin.problem_it_solves: string — pain point, gap, or opportunity
origin.creators_background: string — who built it and what drove them
origin.v1_vs_now: string — how different was the first version

indirect_alternatives: string — different approaches to same underlying problem

current_state.adoption_metrics: string — users, revenue, downloads, whatever applies
current_state.next_focus: string — what the team is working on next

identity.name: string
identity.date_range: string — when it started and ended (or 'ongoing')
identity.type: string — war, crisis, election, revolution, disaster, etc.
identity.known_as: string — one-line summary of what happened and why it mattered

enabling_conditions: string — what had to be true for the spark to catch
deep_roots: string — structural/historical/systemic factors, years or decades back
path_dependencies: string — earlier decisions that made this outcome increasingly likely
offramps_not_taken: string — moments where it could have gone differently

chronology.on_the_ground: string — what people experienced, specific accounts

consequences.what_didnt_change: string — expected changes that didn't materialize

current_state.current_situation: string — for ongoing events, or lasting legacy for concluded ones

identity.name: string
identity.known_as: string — one-paragraph definition for a smart non-expert

genesis.the_problem: string — intellectual puzzle or practical need that gave rise to this
precursors: string — earlier ideas that laid the groundwork
genesis.the_breakthrough: string — key insight, what made it different
genesis.context: string — what was happening in the field/world that made this moment ripe
genesis.initial_reception: string — embraced? ignored? attacked? by whom?

core_content.central_claim: string — the core idea stated clearly and precisely
key_components: string — building blocks of the concept
core_content.mechanism_or_logic: string — how the argument or framework works
assumptions: string — what must be true for this to hold
core_content.scope: string — where it applies and where it doesn't
formal_definitions: string | null — equations, models, precise formulations

branches: string — schools of thought or competing versions
cross_field_adoption: string — how other fields adapted it

strongest_critiques: string — most serious objections, presented fairly
competing_frameworks: string — alternative theories addressing same questions
open_questions: string — what it doesn't yet explain
active_controversies: string — current disputes and fault lines

current_state.expert_consensus: string — how practitioners currently view it

identity.name: string
identity.type: string — market, industry, ecosystem, geopolitical order, etc.
identity.participants: string — who operates within this system

mechanics.structure: string — main components, layers, or sectors
mechanics.flows: string — what moves through: money, goods, information, people, power
mechanics.incentive_structures: string — what the system rewards and punishes
feedback_loops: string — self-reinforcing dynamics and balancing forces
bottlenecks: string — choke points where small changes produce large effects
mechanics.rules: string — formal regulations and informal norms

key_players.name: string — individual, company, government, or group

history.formation: string — when and how this system emerged
durable_features: string — what has persisted despite change

active_tensions: string — unresolved forces pulling in different directions

emerging_dynamics: string — new forces just beginning to be felt
